    Plan rules & terms

    • 1
      Lunch & dinner only

      Our Veg and Non-veg plans include lunch and dinner only. Breakfast is separate and has to be added: ₹1100 per month, or only ₹300 for Saturday & Sunday breakfast.

    • 2
      30-day plan

      Each monthly plan is for 30 days (lunch + dinner).

    • 3
      Extension rule – 37 days

      Your plan can be extended up to a maximum of 37 days. All meals must be finished before the 37-day cycle expires.

    • 4
      No refund

      Once a monthly plan is taken, no refund will be given for any reason.

    • 5
      Menu substitutions

      If any item is not available with us, we may change it with another suitable item.

    • 6
      Trial / demo meal – ₹70 per meal

      Taste first, then decide. A trial (demo) meal is available at ₹70 per meal before you subscribe.
